title: Microsoft-provided SMS and voice MFA retires on 1 February 2027
summary: Microsoft is retiring the SMS and voice authentication it delivers itself in Microsoft Entra ID, including for SSPR, and is moving users to passkeys by default. From 1 February 2027, users whose only MFA method is SMS or voice get a blocking prompt to register a passkey; Global Administrators and external users follow on 1 July 2027, while internal guests stay on the February date. Update 2 November 2026: Choose Your Own Telephony provider (CYOT) became generally available on 30 October 2026, so tenants with a real need can keep SMS and voice through a provider bought in Microsoft Security Store. Update 13 November 2026: from mid-November Entra may show a risk-based Arkose Labs CAPTCHA before sending SMS/voice MFA codes (MC1551151); it does not change the retirement dates, but blocked arkoselabs.com egress makes SMS/voice MFA fail outright.
why: If many users still rely on text messages or phone calls, they will all hit a blocking registration prompt on the same day, and your service desk will feel it. CYOT is a paid escape hatch, not a default: it needs an Azure subscription and a provider contract, so decide early who genuinely needs telephony. Passkeys are phishing-resistant, so moving early improves security.
todo: Find who still depends on SMS or voice with the usage script and the entra-sms-voice-usage-analyzer linked from Microsoft's retirement guide.
Enable passkeys (FIDO2) for those users and run a registration campaign well before the date; remember SSPR is in scope too.

Only for users with a business, regulatory or technical need: compare the telephony providers (Microsoft's November 2026 Entra update lists Soprano, Telesign and Infobip), check you have an eligible paid Azure subscription and Owner (or Contributor plus Role Based Access Control Administrator) to buy in Security Store, start CYOT in evaluation mode and ramp traffic in stages.
Plan separately for Global Administrators and external users, who have until 1 July 2027; internal guest users follow the 1 February date.
effective_note: 1 July 2027 for Global Administrators and external users
